thread:
anya: Quick sync on postmortem action items after last night's deploy incident. We need explicit owners, due dates, and a short validation plan for each remediation.

lina: I'll take ownership of the analytics aggregation fix (INC-4832). Plan: audit the bucketing code, add deterministic boundary tests, and run a 7-day backfill to validate. ETA: PR in 5 business days.

derek: I'll own ETL lag mitigations (INC-4833). Immediate tasks: add circuit-breaker metrics, increase ingest parallelism for the hot shards, and patch the retry backoff. Prototype in 3 days, canary in 10 days.

mohit: I'll own tracer completeness (INC-4834). Found that span-emitter silently drops last batch on consumer rebalance. Patch: persist offset after emit ack, add at-least-once sender. Will ship a prototype in 48h.

tara: For QA, I'll build a regression check that compares hourly aggregated totals between old and new pipelines. If difference > 0.2% alert. Will add test harness to CI. ETA: 7 days.

anya: Good. Please add concise validation steps in each ticket. Also add an SLO-driven alert for recurrence: 3 similar incidents in 90 days triggers an on-call review.

derek: Proposed alert for ETL: alert if ingestion latency p95 > 600ms for 5m across >= 50% of active workers. Will add to INC-4833.

mohit: SQL I used to find incomplete traces (saved to INC-4834):
```
SELECT t.id, t.expected_spans, COUNT(s.id) AS got
FROM traces t LEFT JOIN spans s ON t.id = s.trace_id
WHERE t.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY t.id, t.expected_spans
HAVING COUNT(s.id) < t.expected_spans;
```

lina: Observed root cause for aggregation skew: floating point window rounding when bucket width is not divisor of window size. Short-term fix: use integer nanoseconds for boundaries, long-term: centralize bucketing util. Putting notes in INC-4832.

ops-bot: Created INC-4832 (aggregation, owner=lina), INC-4833 (etl-lag, owner=derek), INC-4834 (tracing, owner=mohit).

tara: I'll coordinate QA signoff and will require: unit tests, e2e replay with synthetic load, and 48h canary metrics. Adding checklist to each ticket.

anya: Recurrence mitigation: add "obs-regression" nightly job that runs the critical checks (span completeness, aggregation totals, ingest latency) and creates a P1 if any check fails for 2 consecutive runs. Who can own the job?

lina: I can own the nightly job setup and alerts for 2 weeks while it's stable.

mohit: Also recommend adding a lightweight pre-deploy test that runs a small synthetic trace through the emitter to catch span drops before deploy. Can add to canary gate.

derek: I'll add the pre-deploy synthetic to our deploy pipeline (small script + smoke check).

ops-bot: Scheduled follow-up review "obs-remediation-check" on 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC.

anya: Please update tickets with PR links, set due dates (no more than 14 days unless blocked), and mark blocked if needing infra changes. We'll do a status check at the scheduled review. :thumbsup: 

lina: ack

mohit: ack

tara: ack
